Walk-in-Interview for Engagement of Junior Engineer (Civil) on Contractual basis for the
Project "Development of Coastal area under DSDA'
Applications are invitbd from eligible and interested candidates for engagement to the post of
]unior Engineer (Civil) for "Development of Coastal area under DSDA' Project on purely
contractual basis under Digha Sankarpur Development Authority (DSDA).
1. Name of the Post : Junior Engineer (Civil)
2. Number of Posts : 01 (One)
3. Nature of Engagement : Contractual (initially for 01 year, may be extended on satisfactory
performance and requirement of the Authority for the Project)
4. Essential Qualification :
i) Diploma in Civil Engineering from an institution recognized by the Government or a
Degree in Civil Engineering from a University or Institute recognized by the
Government.
ii) The candidate must possess working knowledge of computers and knowledge of
AutoCAD.
iii) Knowledge of preparation of civil engineering drawings, estimates, measurements,
and Biils of Quantities (BOQ) shali be essential.
Desirable Qualificatio4r/Experience :
i) Minimum 2 years of relevant working experience in civil constructiory supervision,
'maintenance, repair, renovation, and development of buildings and allied
infraskucture shall be preferred.
ii) Experience in site supervision, measurement of work, preparation of estimates,
checking of contractors' bills, and monitoring of constructign quality and progress
shall be desirable.
iii) Ifuowledge of e-tendering procedures, Government works-related formalities, and
relevant technical specifications shall be preferred.

F Undertake regular site visits and assist in the supervision of civil construction and a11ied
infrastructure works.
) Assist in the preparation of estimates, technical specifications, drawings, tender
documents, and Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
F Carry out measulements of executed work and maintain measurement records in

F Assist in checking contractors' bills, measurement sheets, and other documents relating to
payment.
